purpose: prove end-to-end learnability and controlability before exhaustive Phase R0
principles: do not change the formal model architecture
do not change 13x5-min history or 12x10-min H120 horizon
do not change Engineering36 or K<=8
do not use reserved Challenge/Formal Blind evidence
audit the selected core at full finite-value fidelity
require numeric same-state and same-future-rainfall four-reference alignment
use learning curves to decide whether more evidence is likely to help
failure caused by model/target bias must not trigger blind bulk data expansion

step1.pilot_goal: demonstrate held-out rainfall-group state reconstruction learnability

step2.pilot_goal: demonstrate hydraulic trajectory and PFV/TFV/Peak directional/ranking learnability

step3.pilot_goal: verify candidate opportunity exists and safe candidates can be ranked/selected

completion_meaning: technical feasibility demonstrated; expand only the evidence dimensions shown necessary before returning to the formal paper workflow
